blocks.text: A landscape big enough to explore

blocks.markdown:
This fictional commerce landscape contains **40 entities and 44 selected relations**. It exercises search, focus, group layout and independent canvas navigation. It is not a recommended service decomposition.

Start with the whole map to find a boundary, then read one of the focused views. A dense graph cannot make every label legible at a single fit scale; multiple views preserve shared meaning while lowering the reading load.

blocks.title: One model, three views
blocks.text: Search for ?payment? and select Payment adapter. Inspect its details, then compare the checkout view below. Shared IDs keep the object consistent; each view keeps its own positions and zoom.

blocks.markdown: The checkout view keeps access, order handling, stock and payment responsibilities together. Edges are selected dependencies; their placement does not define the sequence of a request.

The background view centers fulfillment, communication, transport and operational insight. A replay path is shown as a dependency, not as permission to replay any event blindly. A real system would define retention, access controls and recovery procedures separately.
